citations.title: Hover | GenAI Notice
excerpts: Hover's GenAI uses custom generative AI technology in combination with pre-trained publicly accessible generative AI technologies in accordance with their respective licenses. The Hover GenAI Dataset is used in further development and/or validation of other pre-trained publicly accessible generative AI technologies. These other technologies are described in more detail at the following publicly accessible links: [Stable Diffusion](https://huggingface.co/stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5) , [Realistic Vision](https://huggingface.co/SG161222/Realistic_Vision_V6.0_B1_noVAE) , [Metric3D](https://huggingface.co/zachL1/Metric3D) , [OneFormer](https://huggingface.co/shi-labs/oneformer_ade20k_swin_large) , [MLSD](https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/sd-controlnet-mlsd) , and [NormalBAE](https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/control_v11p_sd15_normalbae) . The Hover GenAI Dataset is used to enhance the Hover GenAI as conditional control (a "ControlNet") of other generative AI technologies, including to constrain geometry and enhance segmentation of input content.

basis.reasoning: Hover's GenAI disclosure describes custom technology combined with pretrained technologies and explicitly names Stable Diffusion, Realistic Vision, Metric3D, OneFormer, MLSD, and NormalBAE. The answer preserves the development/validation context rather than claiming universal runtime use.
